I have been farming maize here in the North East for many years, and with 2.59 hectares of rented land, I must be careful with my money. I will buy some bags of NPK fertilizer because the soil here is tired, but I cannot afford too much, so I will apply what I can and hope the rains come well. I will use improved seed because it gives better yield than our local seed, and I will spray herbicide to save my family from too much weeding by hand. I will not irrigate because we have no water pump here, and I will need to hire some young men to help at planting and harvest time since my children are not always around.
